sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch. for...in 'iterates over all enumerable string properties of an object ... including inherited enumerable properties' from the prototype chain; for arrays it 'will return all enumerable properties, including those with non-integer names and those that are inherited'; prefer for, forEach or for...of. scoring.modelReasoning: The 'sum' line arrived with Array.prototype.sum. Assigning to the prototype creates an enumerable property that every array inherits, and the vendor CSV library loops with for...in, which visits inherited enumerable keys. Remove the prototype method and export a plain sum(xs) function. Defining it non-enumerable hides it from for...in but still modifies a shared built-in; adding hasOwn checks to our code misses the vendor loop.
